mechanism_gain.name: deterministic proportional-feedback occupation-control theorem
mechanism_gain.statement: For the exact one-shell scaled equation, with the source-valid OU seed, feedback active only on the seed event a<=Z_1<=2a, deterministic 0<=gamma(t)<=1 on that event, and Y=-Z off that event, the high-tail endpoint has exact logarithmic exponent 2/3 in the amplitude-log scale. Uniformly, R^3 mu{|Z|>R} <= C ||Y||_3^3 (1+log(R/a))^2 for R>=2 e a; the constant-feedback witnesses from the preceding run show every exponent alpha<2/3 fails in this class.
mechanism_gain.scope: restricted source-valid control class on the exact frozen pair; not the full Problem 3 theorem and not a proof that alpha_*(T)=2/3 for arbitrary progressive inputs
